title: Biggio 2017 racket tool-use PPS - no racket session
citation: Biggio, M., Bisio, A., Avanzino, L., Ruggeri, P., & Bove, M. (2017). This racket is not mine: The influence of the tool-use on peripersonal space. Neuropsychologia, 103, 54-58.
notes: No-racket session of the reported static near/far audio-tactile PPS task. It preserves the 90-trial session unit: 30 near audio-tactile targets, 30 far audio-tactile targets, and 30 sound-only catches split equally across near/far locations. Exact pink-noise file, far lead, ITI, response timeout, and electrical tactile pulse/current were not reported, so those are labelled as toolkit defaults or derived approximations.

reference_parameters.derived_far_sound_lead_basis: Paper reports a qualitative far-sound lead for propagation compensation; 2 ms is a speed-of-sound approximation for 68.5 cm and is not an author-reported value.
reference_parameters.reported_geometry: Near loudspeaker close to the right hand; hand about 30 cm from body; far loudspeaker about 68.5 cm beyond the near loudspeaker at the racket-tip location in racket sessions.
reference_parameters.reported_tactile_stimulus: DS7AH HV Digitimer electrical stimulation at the right wrist through a surface bipolar electrode; exact pulse duration/current not reported.
reference_parameters.reported_response_rule: Verbal response as fast as possible to tactile targets; ignore sounds and withhold responses on sound-only catches.
reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: Per session: 30 near audio-tactile target + 30 far audio-tactile target + 15 near sound-only catch + 15 far sound-only catch = 90 trials.
reference_parameters.minimum_runnable_profile_scope: No-racket session only; common-racket and personal-racket sessions are companion templates.
nonblocking_caveats: exact pink-noise source file, seed, and spectrum recipe not supplied
exact far-sound lead not reported; stored as a derived 2 ms approximation
exact electrical tactile pulse duration/current/calibration not reported
ITI/jitter policy and numeric response deadline not reported
voice-key threshold and latency correction not reported

provenance.source: Manual review records 30 near targets, 30 far targets, and 30 sound-only catches per session.
